planning.product_summary: AI Gym Tracker is a web application designed for the general audience, utilizing AI-powered technology to track and analyze fitness data. The application will be built using a microservices architecture, with a tech stack including React, Node.js, Express.js, and PostgreSQL or MongoDB database. The application will integrate with Google Fit or Apple Health for fitness data and Stripe or PayPal for payment processing.
features: Integration with Google Fit or Apple Health
Payment processing using Stripe or PayPal
user_stories: As a user, I want to create a profile and track my fitness data so that I can monitor my progress and set goals.
As a user, I want to integrate my Google Fit or Apple Health data with the application so that I can easily track my workouts and activities.
As a user, I want to receive personalized workout recommendations based on my fitness goals and preferences so that I can optimize my workout routine.
As a user, I want to be able to share my progress on social media and connect with other users so that I can stay motivated and accountable.
functional_requirements: The application shall allow users to create and manage their profiles, including setting fitness goals and tracking progress.
The application shall integrate with Google Fit or Apple Health to retrieve fitness data and track workouts.
The application shall use AI-powered algorithms to analyze fitness data and provide personalized workout recommendations.
The application shall allow users to make payments using Stripe or PayPal.
The application shall provide a user-friendly interface for tracking progress, setting goals, and accessing personalized recommendations.
non_functional_requirements: The application shall be built using a microservices architecture to ensure scalability and maintainability.
The application shall use a PostgreSQL or MongoDB database to store user data and fitness information.
The application shall utilize JWT Bearer Tokens with bcrypt hashing and refresh tokens for authentication and authorization.
The application shall be deployed on Render or Railway to ensure high availability and scalability.
The application shall use Redis for caching and load balancing using reverse proxies to optimize performance.
success_metrics: Number of integrations with Google Fit or Apple Health
Number of payments processed using Stripe or PayPal

planning.product_summary: The AI Gym Tracker is a web application designed for the general audience, utilizing AI-powered technology to track and analyze user fitness data. The application will be built using a microservices architecture with a tech stack consisting of React, Node.js, Express.js, and PostgreSQL or MongoDB. The AI Gym Tracker aims to provide users with a personalized fitness experience, offering features such as workout tracking, fitness goal setting, and progress analysis.
features: User registration and login functionality with JWT Bearer Tokens and bcrypt hashing
Integration with Google Fit or Apple Health for fitness data retrieval
Personalized fitness goal setting and progress tracking
Payment processing with Stripe or PayPal for premium features
Social sharing and community features for user engagement
user_stories: As a user, I want to be able to register and log in to the application securely, so I can access my fitness data and track my progress.
As a user, I want to be able to connect my Google Fit or Apple Health account to the application, so I can easily retrieve my fitness data.
As a user, I want to be able to set and track my fitness goals, so I can stay motivated and focused on my fitness journey.
As a user, I want to be able to view and analyze my workout data, so I can identify areas for improvement and optimize my fitness routine.
As a user, I want to be able to share my fitness progress on social media, so I can stay accountable and engage with the fitness community.
functional_requirements: The application shall provide a secure registration and login system, utilizing JWT Bearer Tokens and bcrypt hashing.
The application shall integrate with Google Fit or Apple Health to retrieve user fitness data.
The application shall utilize AI-powered technology to track and analyze user workout data.
The application shall provide users with personalized fitness goal setting and progress tracking features.
The application shall implement payment processing with Stripe or PayPal for premium features.
non_functional_requirements: The application shall be built using a microservices architecture with a tech stack consisting of React, Node.js, Express.js, and PostgreSQL or MongoDB.
The application shall utilize Docker containers for horizontal scaling and load balancing with reverse proxies.
The application shall implement stateless services for improved scalability and utilize an API Gateway for routing and traffic management.
The application shall use Redis or In-Memory caching for improved performance.
The application shall be deployed on Render or Railway for cloud hosting.
success_metrics: User engagement and retention rates, measured by daily active users and user retention over time.
Fitness goal achievement rates, measured by the percentage of users who achieve their set fitness goals.
User satisfaction and feedback, measured by surveys and reviews.
Revenue growth, measured by the increase in premium feature subscriptions and payment processing transactions.
Application performance and scalability, measured by response times, error rates, and system uptime.
